\section[(dialogue)]{The body and describing words — a first pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R126-first-pass-the-body-and-describing-words}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for bad; nasty and kind.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a price, football, a concert, a party, a wish
  \item fog, a storm, ice, a hill, a rock
  \item a wave, a desert, a volcano, a cave, a waterfall
  \item a donkey, a rabbit, a tiger, a butterfly, a frog
  \item a tortoise, a squirrel, an owl, a whale, a dolphin
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A price? (\textbf{il prezzo}.) Football? (\textbf{il calcio}.) A concert? (\textbf{il concerto}.) A party? (\textbf{la festa}.) A wish? (\textbf{il desiderio}.) Fog? (\textbf{la nebbia}.) A storm? (\textbf{il temporale}.) Ice? (\textbf{il ghiaccio}.) A hill? (\textbf{la collina}.) A rock? (\textbf{la roccia}.) A wave? (\textbf{l'onda}.) A desert? (\textbf{il deserto}.) A volcano? (\textbf{il vulcano}.) A cave? (\textbf{la grotta}.) A waterfall? (\textbf{la cascata}.) A donkey? (\textbf{l'asino}.) A rabbit? (\textbf{il coniglio}.) A tiger? (\textbf{la tigre}.) A butterfly? (\textbf{la farfalla}.) A frog? (\textbf{la rana}.) A tortoise? (\textbf{la tartaruga}.) A squirrel? (\textbf{lo scoiattolo}.) An owl? (\textbf{il gufo}.) A whale? (\textbf{la balena}.) A dolphin? (\textbf{il delfino}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{More describing words — a second pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R126-second-pass-more-describing-words}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an elbow and an ankle.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item an elbow, an ankle, a wrist, a cheek, lips
  \item pink, purple, brown, orange, pretty
  \item busy; taken, free, open, closed, quiet
  \item noisy, last, famous, important, interesting
  \item boring, fun, nice, bad; nasty, kind
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An elbow? (\textbf{il gomito}.) An ankle? (\textbf{la caviglia}.) A wrist? (\textbf{il polso}.) A cheek? (\textbf{la guancia}.) Lips? (\textbf{le labbra}.) Pink? (\textbf{rosa}.) Purple? (\textbf{viola}.) Brown? (\textbf{marrone}.) Orange? (\textbf{arancione}.) Pretty? (\textbf{carino}.) Busy; taken? (\textbf{occupato}.) Free? (\textbf{libero}.) Open? (\textbf{aperto}.) Closed? (\textbf{chiuso}.) Quiet? (\textbf{tranquillo}.) Noisy? (\textbf{rumoroso}.) Last? (\textbf{ultimo}.) Famous? (\textbf{famoso}.) Important? (\textbf{importante}.) Interesting? (\textbf{interessante}.) Boring? (\textbf{noioso}.) Fun? (\textbf{divertente}.) Nice? (\textbf{simpatico}.) Bad; nasty? (\textbf{cattivo}.) Kind? (\textbf{gentile}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
